---
geometry: margin=1.7cm
params:
  meta_json: "{}"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    df_print: paged
  pdf_document:
    toc: false
    fig_caption: yes
    keep_tex: yes
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{float}
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
  - \usepackage{longtable}
  - \usepackage{fancyhdr}
  - \usepackage{lastpage}
  - \setlength{\tabcolsep}{4pt}
  - \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.08}
  - \setlength{\headheight}{14pt}
  - \pagestyle{fancy}
  - \fancyhf{}
  - \fancyhead[L]{ARDaC Anagine report}
  - \fancyhead[R]{AlcHepNet ARDaC Anagine}
  - \fancyfoot[C]{Page \thepage\ of \pageref{LastPage}}
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(jsonlite)
  library(dplyr)
  library(knitr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tidyr)
  library(survival)
})

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.pos = "H"
)

meta <- tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(params$meta_json, flatten = TRUE), error = function(e) list())
requested_by <- if (!is.null(meta$requested_by)) as.character(meta$requested_by)[1] else ""
if (is.na(requested_by) || requested_by == "") requested_by <- ""

escape_latex_text <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x) || x == "") return("")
  x <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\textbackslash{}", x)
  x <- gsub("([#$%&_{}])", "\\\\\\1", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("~", "\\\\textasciitilde{}", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\\^", "\\\\textasciicircum{}", x, perl = TRUE)
  x
}

df <- meta$fetchedData
if (is.null(df) || length(df) == 0) {
  df <- data.frame()
} else if (is.list(df) && !is.data.frame(df)) {
  df <- dplyr::bind_rows(df)
} else {
  df <- as.data.frame(df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

required_df_columns <- c(
  "pat_id", "project_id", "cohort", "study_site", "study_name",
  "actarm", "case_arm", "aki_status", "days_to_aki", "days_90_aki", "days_180_aki",
  "vital_status", "days_to_death", "days_90_survival", "days_180_survival",
  "age_at_index", "gender", "race", "ethnicity",
  "drinking_frequency", "drinks_per_day",
  "follow_up_id", "visit_day",
  "bmi", "tlfb_number_drinks", "tlfb_drinking_days",
  "meld_score", "child_pugh_score", "maddreys_score",
  "alcohol_use_baseline",
  "estimated_gfr_mdrd", "albumin", "total_bilirubin", "direct_bilirubin",
  "creatinine", "alt", "ast", "alkaline_phosphatase", "total_protein",
  "hemoglobin", "total_wbc", "platelet_count", "mcv", "inr", "pt_seconds"
)

missing_df_columns <- setdiff(required_df_columns, names(df))
if (length(missing_df_columns) > 0) {
  for (col in missing_df_columns) df[[col]] <- rep(NA, nrow(df))
}
df <- df[, unique(c(required_df_columns, names(df))), drop = FALSE]

field_availability <- meta$fieldAvailability
if (is.null(field_availability) || length(field_availability) == 0) {
  field_availability <- data.frame()
} else if (is.list(field_availability) && !is.data.frame(field_availability)) {
  field_availability <- dplyr::bind_rows(field_availability)
} else {
  field_availability <- as.data.frame(field_availability, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

unavailable_fields <- meta$unavailableFields
if (is.null(unavailable_fields) || length(unavailable_fields) == 0) unavailable_fields <- character()
unavailable_fields <- as.character(unavailable_fields)
unavailable_fields <- unavailable_fields[!is.na(unavailable_fields) & unavailable_fields != ""]

biospecimen_summary <- meta$biospecimenSummary
if (is.null(biospecimen_summary) || length(biospecimen_summary) == 0) {
  biospecimen_summary <- list()
}

lab_result_summary <- meta$labResultSummary
if (is.null(lab_result_summary) || length(lab_result_summary) == 0) {

}

participant_level_data <- meta$participantLevelData
if (is.null(participant_level_data) || length(participant_level_data) == 0) {
  participant_level_data <- data.frame()
} else if (is.list(participant_level_data) && !is.data.frame(participant_level_data)) {
  participant_level_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(participant_level_data)
} else {
  participant_level_data <- as.data.frame(participant_level_data, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

generated_at <- as.character(meta$generated_at %||% "")
if (length(generated_at) == 0 || is.na(generated_at[1]) || generated_at[1] == "") {
  gt <- Sys.time()
} else {
  ga <- generated_at[1]
  ga <- sub("Z$", "+0000", ga)
  ga <- sub("([+-][0-9]{2}):([0-9]{2})$", "\\1\\2", ga)
  gt <- as.POSIXct(ga, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OS%z", tz = "UTC")
  if (is.na(gt)) gt <- Sys.time()
}

report_month <- format(gt, "%B, %Y")
report_date <- format(gt, "%B %d, %Y")
gt_et <- as.POSIXct(format(gt, tz = "America/New_York", usetz = TRUE), tz = "America/New_York")
report_time <- format(gt_et, "%I:%M %p %Z")
run_info_generated_at <- paste(report_date, "at", report_time)

} else if (source_index == "molecular_test") {

} else if (source_index == "follow_up") {

short_project <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == "ARDaC-AlcHepNet" ~ "AlcHepNet",
    x == "ARDaC-Treat" ~ "Treat",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

short_site <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == "Virginia Commonwealth University" ~ "VCU",
    x == "University of Louisville" ~ "Louisville",
    x == "Cleveland Clinic" ~ "Cleveland",
    x == "Mayo Clinic" ~ "Mayo",
    x == "Indiana University" ~ "Indiana",
    x == "University of Pittsburgh" ~ "Pittsburgh",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

ensure_columns <- function(input_df, cols) {
  if (is.null(input_df) || !is.data.frame(input_df)) {
    input_df <- data.frame()
  }
  for (col in cols) {
    if (!col %in% names(input_df)) {
      input_df[[col]] <- rep(NA, nrow(input_df))
    }
  }
  input_df
}

fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return("NA")
  format(round(mean(x), digits), nsmall = digits)
}

fmt_sd <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) <= 1) return("NA")
  format(round(stats::sd(x), digits), nsmall = digits)
}

fmt_median_iqr <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return("NA")
  q <- stats::quantile(x, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)
  paste0(
    format(round(q[[2]], digits), nsmall = digits),
    " (",
    format(round(q[[1]], digits), nsmall = digits),
    ", ",
    format(round(q[[3]], digits), nsmall = digits),
    ")"
  )
}

count_pct <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0) return(data.frame())
  tab <- sort(table(x, useNA = "no"), decreasing = TRUE)
  tab <- tab[tab > 0]
  if (length(tab) == 0) return(data.frame())
  data.frame(
    Category = names(tab),
    Count = as.integer(tab),
    Percent = paste0(round(100 * as.integer(tab) / sum(tab), 1), "%"),
    row.names = NULL,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

count_pct_from_summary <- function(items, value_col = "value", count_col = "count", label = "Category") {
  if (is.null(items) || length(items) == 0) return(data.frame())
  tbl <- if (is.data.frame(items)) items else dplyr::bind_rows(items)
  if (nrow(tbl) == 0 || !(value_col %in% names(tbl)) || !(count_col %in% names(tbl))) return(data.frame())
  total_n <- sum(as.numeric(tbl[[count_col]]), na.rm = TRUE)
  out <- data.frame(
    Category = as.character(tbl[[value_col]]),
    Count = as.integer(tbl[[count_col]]),
    Percent = if (total_n > 0) paste0(round(100 * as.numeric(tbl[[count_col]]) / total_n, 1), "%") else "0%",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  names(out)[1] <- label
  out
}

render_table <- function(tbl, caption, align = NULL) {
  fmt <- if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "latex" else "html"
  args <- list(
    x = tbl,
    format = fmt,
    caption = caption,
    align = align,
    booktabs = knitr::is_latex_output(),
    longtable = knitr::is_latex_output(),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  out <- do.call(knitr::kable, args)
  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
    out <- paste0("\\begingroup\\small\n", out, "\n\\endgroup\n")
  }
  cat(out)
  invisible(NULL)
}

run_info_metrics <- c(
  "Generated at",
  "Linked participants",
  "Linked follow-ups",

)

run_info_values <- c(

  as.character(meta$participantCount %||% 0),

)

  run_info_metrics <- append(run_info_metrics, c(matching_count_label, fetched_count_label), after = 1)
  run_info_values <- append(run_info_values, c(as.character(source_total_match_count), as.character(source_fetched_row_count)), after = 1)
} else {
  run_info_metrics <- append(run_info_metrics, selected_count_label, after = 1)

}

if (length(kernel_value) > 0 && !is.na(kernel_value[1])) {

}

  run_info_values <- append(run_info_values, kernel_value, after = 1)
}

run_info <- data.frame(

truncation_note <- NULL

  } else if (source_index == "molecular_test") {

filters <- meta$filters$sourceFilters
filter_table <- data.frame()
if (!is.null(filters) && length(filters) > 0) {
  to_vals <- function(x) {
    if (is.list(x) && !is.null(x$selectedValues)) {
      paste(x$selectedValues, collapse = ", ")
    } else if (is.list(x) && (!is.null(x$lowerBound) || !is.null(x$upperBound))) {
      paste0("[", x$lowerBound %||% "-inf", ", ", x$upperBound %||% "+inf", "]")
    } else {
      as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(x, auto_unbox = TRUE))
    }
  }

  filter_table <- data.frame(
    Field = names(filters),
    Value = vapply(filters, to_vals, FUN.VALUE = character(1)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

make_availability_table <- function(input_df, availability_override = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(availability_override) && nrow(availability_override) > 0) {
    override_df <- as.data.frame(availability_override, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    required_cols <- c("field", "availableCount", "missingCount", "availablePercent")
    if (all(required_cols %in% names(override_df))) {
      override_df <- override_df %>% filter(!(field %in% unavailable_fields))
      return(override_df %>%
        mutate(
          Field = ifelse(field %in% names(field_labels), unname(field_labels[field]), field),
          `Available values` = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(availableCount)),
          `Missing values` = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(missingCount)),
          Coverage = paste0(`Available values`, "/", `Available values` + `Missing values`, " (", availablePercent, "%)")
        ) %>%
        select(Field, `Available values`, `Missing values`, Coverage))
    }
  }
  if (nrow(input_df) == 0) return(data.frame())
  expected_fields <- setdiff(intersect(names(field_labels), names(input_df)), unavailable_fields)
  data.frame(
    field = expected_fields,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      availableCount = sum(!is.na(input_df[[field]]) & input_df[[field]] != ""),
      missingCount = nrow(input_df) - availableCount,
      availablePercent = if (nrow(input_df) > 0) round(100 * availableCount / nrow(input_df), 1) else 0
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      Field = ifelse(field %in% names(field_labels), unname(field_labels[field]), field),
      `Available values` = availableCount,
      `Missing values` = missingCount,
      Coverage = paste0(availableCount, "/", availableCount + missingCount, " (", availablePercent, "%)")
    ) %>%
    select(Field, `Available values`, `Missing values`, Coverage)
}

make_metrics_table <- function(input_df) {
  if (nrow(input_df) == 0) return(data.frame())
  available_numeric <- setdiff(numeric_fields[numeric_fields %in% names(input_df)], unavailable_fields)
  if (length(available_numeric) == 0) return(data.frame())
  data.frame(
    Field = ifelse(available_numeric %in% names(field_labels), unname(field_labels[available_numeric]), available_numeric),
    `Mean (SD)` = vapply(available_numeric, function(col) {
      paste0(fmt_num(input_df[[col]]), " (", fmt_sd(input_df[[col]]), ")")
    }, FUN.VALUE = character(1)),
    `Median (IQR)` = vapply(available_numeric, function(col) {
      fmt_median_iqr(input_df[[col]])
    }, FUN.VALUE = character(1)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

make_overview_table <- function(input_df) {
  if (nrow(input_df) == 0) return(data.frame())
  data.frame(
    Metric = c(
      "Rows included",
      "Unique participants",
      "Visit days represented",
      "BMI median (IQR)",
      "MELD median (IQR)",
      "Child-Pugh median (IQR)",
      "Maddrey median (IQR)"
    ),
    Value = c(
      nrow(input_df),
      dplyr::n_distinct(input_df$pat_id),
      paste(sort(unique(input_df$visit_day[is.finite(input_df$visit_day)])), collapse = ", "),
      fmt_median_iqr(input_df$bmi),
      fmt_median_iqr(input_df$meld_score),
      fmt_median_iqr(input_df$child_pugh_score),
      fmt_median_iqr(input_df$maddreys_score)
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

visit_label <- function(x) {
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  out <- rep("Unknown visit day", length(x_num))
  finite_idx <- is.finite(x_num)
  rounded <- x_num[finite_idx]
  rounded[abs(rounded - round(rounded)) < 1e-9] <- round(rounded[abs(rounded - round(rounded)) < 1e-9])
  out[finite_idx] <- paste0("Visit day ", rounded)
  out
}

to_num_vec <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))
}

to_chr_vec <- function(x) {
  trimws(as.character(x))
}

first_non_missing_num <- function(...) {
  vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(list(...), use.names = FALSE)))
  vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
  if (length(vals) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  vals[[1]]
}

normalize_status <- function(x) {
  trimws(tolower(as.character(x)))
}

preferred_group_order <- function(group_mode) {
  switch(
    group_mode,
    sex = c("Female", "Male"),
    obs_group = c("AH cases", "Heavy Drinking Controls", "Healthy Controls", "RCT patients"),
    treatment_arm = c("OBS patients", "Anakinra + Zinc", "Prednisone"),
    "All"
  )
}

ordered_groups <- function(groups, group_mode) {
  groups <- unique(as.character(groups))
  preferred <- preferred_group_order(group_mode)
  c(preferred[preferred %in% groups], sort(setdiff(groups, preferred)))
}

km_palette <- function(groups, group_mode) {
  groups <- as.character(groups)
  cols <- setNames(grDevices::hcl.colors(length(groups), "Dark 3"), groups)
  overrides <- switch(
    group_mode,
    sex = c("Female" = "#2F8DE4", "Male" = "#F14B3A"),
    obs_group = c("AH cases" = "#2F8DE4", "Heavy Drinking Controls" = "#6E63C6", "Healthy Controls" = "#4CAF50", "RCT patients" = "#F14B3A"),
    treatment_arm = c("OBS patients" = "#2F8DE4", "Anakinra + Zinc" = "#F14B3A", "Prednisone" = "#4CAF50"),
    c("All" = "#2F8DE4")
  )
  for (name in intersect(names(overrides), groups)) cols[[name]] <- overrides[[name]]
  cols[groups]
}

build_participant_analysis_df <- function(input_df) {
  if (nrow(input_df) == 0) return(data.frame())
  input_df %>%
    distinct(pat_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      project_short = short_project(project_id),
      cohort_clean = ifelse(is.na(cohort) | trimws(cohort) == "", NA_character_, trimws(as.character(cohort))),
      case_arm_clean = dplyr::coalesce(
        dplyr::na_if(trimws(as.character(case_arm)), ""),
        dplyr::na_if(trimws(as.character(actarm)), "")
      ),
      case_arm_clean = dplyr::case_when(
        case_arm_clean %in% c("Anakinra + Zinc", "Prednisone") ~ case_arm_clean,
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      obs_group = dplyr::case_when(
        project_short == "Treat" ~ "RCT patients",
        cohort_clean %in% c("AH cases", "Heavy Drinking Controls", "Healthy Controls") ~ cohort_clean,
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      treatment_arm_group = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(case_arm_clean) ~ case_arm_clean,
        project_short == "AlcHepNet" ~ "OBS patients",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      sex_group = dplyr::case_when(
        trimws(as.character(gender)) %in% c("Female", "Male") ~ trimws(as.character(gender)),
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
}

prepare_km_df <- function(input_df, outcome = c("death", "aki"), group_mode = c("none", "sex", "obs_group", "treatment_arm"), horizon = 180) {
  outcome <- match.arg(outcome)
  group_mode <- match.arg(group_mode)
  if (nrow(input_df) == 0) return(data.frame())

  death_time_raw <- to_num_vec(input_df$days_to_death)
  death_censor <- dplyr::coalesce(to_num_vec(input_df$days_180_survival), to_num_vec(input_df$days_90_survival), rep(horizon, nrow(input_df)))
  death_status <- normalize_status(input_df$vital_status)
  death_event_raw <- death_status %in% c("dead", "deceased")

  aki_time_raw <- to_num_vec(input_df$days_to_aki)
  aki_censor <- dplyr::coalesce(to_num_vec(input_df$days_180_aki), to_num_vec(input_df$days_90_aki), rep(horizon, nrow(input_df)))
  aki_status <- normalize_status(input_df$aki_status)
  aki_event_raw <- aki_status %in% c("yes", "y", "positive", "1", "true")

  if (outcome == "death") {
    event_time <- death_time_raw
    censor_time <- death_censor
    event_raw <- death_event_raw
  } else {
    event_time <- aki_time_raw
    censor_time <- aki_censor
    event_raw <- aki_event_raw
  }

  observed_time <- dplyr::coalesce(
    ifelse(is.finite(event_time) & event_time >= 0, event_time, NA_real_),
    censor_time
  )
  time <- pmin(pmax(observed_time, 0), horizon)
  event <- ifelse(
    event_raw & is.finite(event_time) & event_time >= 0 & event_time <= horizon,
    1L,
    0L
  )

  group_label <- switch(
    group_mode,
    none = rep("All", nrow(input_df)),
    sex = input_df$sex_group,
    obs_group = input_df$obs_group,
    treatment_arm = input_df$treatment_arm_group
  )

  out <- data.frame(
    pat_id = as.character(input_df$pat_id),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    event = as.integer(event),
    group_label = group_label,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(pat_id), pat_id != "", is.finite(time), time >= 0, !is.na(group_label), group_label != "") %>%
    distinct(pat_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  if (nrow(out) == 0) return(out)

  group_levels <- ordered_groups(unique(out$group_label), group_mode)
  out$group_label <- factor(out$group_label, levels = group_levels)
  out
}

has_km_groups <- function(km_df, min_groups = 1) {
  if (nrow(km_df) == 0) return(FALSE)
  dplyr::n_distinct(km_df$group_label) >= min_groups
}

plot_km_panel <- function(km_df, group_mode = "none", horizon = 180) {
  if (nrow(km_df) == 0) {
    plot.new()
    text(0.5, 0.5, "No analyzable participants were available for this survival analysis.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  fit <- survival::survfit(survival::Surv(time, event) ~ group_label, data = km_df)
  groups <- levels(km_df$group_label)
  cols <- km_palette(groups, group_mode)
  tick_times <- seq(0, horizon, by = 30)
  risk_counts <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(groups, function(group_name) {
      sapply(tick_times, function(t) {
        sum(km_df$group_label == group_name & km_df$time >= t)
      })
    })
  )
  event_counts <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(groups, function(group_name) {
      sapply(tick_times, function(t) {
        sum(km_df$group_label == group_name & km_df$event == 1 & km_df$time <= t)
      })
    })
  )
  rownames(risk_counts) <- groups
  rownames(event_counts) <- groups

  op <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(op), add = TRUE)
  layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3), nrow = 3), heights = c(4.1, 0.85, max(2.2, 1.15 + 0.9 * length(groups))))

  par(mar = c(4.5, 5.8, 6.6, 1.3), ps = 13.5, cex.axis = 1.12, cex.lab = 1.15, cex.main = 1.22, mgp = c(2.3, 0.8, 0))
  plot(
    fit,
    col = cols,
    lwd = 2,
    lty = 1,
    mark.time = FALSE,
    xlim = c(0, horizon),
    ylim = c(0, 1),
    xaxs = "i",
    yaxs = "i",
    xaxt = "n",
    conf.int = FALSE,
    xlab = "Time (days)",
    ylab = "Event-free Survival Probability",
    main = "",
    sub = ""
  )
  axis(1, at = tick_times, labels = tick_times, cex.axis = 1.12)
  title(
    main = "Kaplan-Meier Estimate of Survival Function",
    cex.main = 1.22,
    font.main = 2,
    line = 3.1
  )
  mtext(
    "With Number of Subjects at Risk and Cumulative Events",
    side = 3,
    line = 1.55,
    cex = 1.0,
    col = "#6b7280",
    font = 1
  )
  abline(h = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25), v = tick_times, col = "#d0d7de", lty = 3)
  for (group_name in groups) {
    group_rows <- km_df %>% filter(group_label == group_name)
    censor_times <- sort(group_rows$time[group_rows$event == 0])
    if (length(censor_times) == 0) next
    fit_single <- survival::survfit(survival::Surv(time, event) ~ 1, data = group_rows)
    censor_surv <- summary(fit_single, times = censor_times, extend = TRUE)$surv
    points(
      censor_times,
      censor_surv,
      pch = 3,
      cex = 1.75,
      lwd = 2.8,
      col = cols[[group_name]]
    )
  }
  legend(
    "topright",
    legend = "Censored",
    pch = 3,
    pt.cex = 1.75,
    col = "#6b7280",
    text.col = "#4b5563",
    bty = "o",
    bg = "#ffffff",
    box.col = "#d9dbe3",
    y.intersp = 0.9,
    x.intersp = 0.5,
    cex = 1.04
  )

  par(mar = c(0, 1, 0, 1))
  plot.new()
  legend(
    "center",
    legend = groups,
    col = cols,
    lwd = 2,
    lty = 1,
    pch = 1,
    pt.cex = 1.08,
    bty = "n",
    horiz = length(groups) <= 3,
    ncol = if (length(groups) > 3) 2 else length(groups),
    xpd = NA,
    cex = 1.14
  )

  row_step <- 1.08
  header_block <- 1.9
  top_y <- length(groups) * row_step * 2 + header_block + 0.8
  par(mar = c(0.2, 8.5, 0.5, 1.5))
  plot.new()
  plot.window(xlim = c(-55, horizon), ylim = c(0, top_y))
  header_title_y <- top_y - 0.45
  header_ticks_y <- top_y - 1.15
  first_risk_y <- top_y - header_block - 0.5
  text(mean(range(tick_times)), header_title_y, "Time (days)", cex = 1.12, font = 2, col = "#374151")
  text(tick_times, rep(header_ticks_y, length(tick_times)), labels = tick_times, cex = 1.12, col = "#374151")
  for (i in seq_along(groups)) {
    y_risk <- first_risk_y - (i - 1) * row_step * 2
    y_event <- y_risk - row_step
    text(-6, y_risk, paste0(groups[[i]], " (At Risk)"), adj = 1, col = cols[[i]], cex = 1.14, xpd = NA)
    text(-6, y_event, "(Events)", adj = 1, col = "#6b7280", cex = 1.12, xpd = NA)
    text(tick_times, rep(y_risk, length(tick_times)), labels = risk_counts[groups[[i]], ], cex = 1.14, col = "#374151")
    text(tick_times, rep(y_event, length(tick_times)), labels = event_counts[groups[[i]], ], cex = 1.14, col = "#6b7280")
  }
}

normalize_followup_trial_arm <- function(case_arm, actarm) {
  arm <- dplyr::coalesce(
    dplyr::na_if(trimws(as.character(case_arm)), ""),
    dplyr::na_if(trimws(as.character(actarm)), "")
  )
  dplyr::case_when(
    arm %in% c("Prednisone", "Anakinra + Zinc") ~ arm,
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

normalize_followup_obs_group <- function(cohort) {
  cohort <- trimws(as.character(cohort))
  dplyr::case_when(
    cohort == "Heavy Drinking Controls" ~ "Heavy Drinker without Alcoholic Hepatitis",
    cohort == "AH cases" ~ "Heavy Drinker with Alcoholic Hepatitis",
    cohort == "Healthy Controls" ~ "Healthy Donor",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

prepare_followup_study_metric_df <- function(input_df, metric_name, study_type = c("trial", "observational")) {
  study_type <- match.arg(study_type)
  if (nrow(input_df) == 0 || !metric_name %in% names(input_df)) return(data.frame())

  plot_df <- input_df %>%
    mutate(
      metric_value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[metric_name]])),
      project_short = short_project(project_id),
      treatment_group = normalize_followup_trial_arm(case_arm, actarm),
      obs_group_label = normalize_followup_obs_group(cohort)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(visit_day_num), !is.na(metric_value), !is.na(pat_id), pat_id != "")

  if (study_type == "trial") {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      filter(!is.na(treatment_group)) %>%
      mutate(
        group_label = factor(treatment_group, levels = c("Prednisone", "Anakinra + Zinc"))
      )
  } else {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      filter(!is.na(obs_group_label), is.na(treatment_group)) %>%
      mutate(
        group_label = factor(
          obs_group_label,
          levels = c(
            "Heavy Drinker without Alcoholic Hepatitis",
            "Heavy Drinker with Alcoholic Hepatitis",
            "Healthy Donor"
          )
        )
      )
  }

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(data.frame())

  visit_levels <- sort(unique(plot_df$visit_day_num))
  plot_df %>%
    mutate(
      visit_day_factor = factor(as.character(visit_day_num), levels = as.character(visit_levels))
    ) %>%
    arrange(group_label, pat_id, visit_day_num)
}

plot_followup_metric_boxplot <- function(plot_df, metric_title, study_title, y_label, palette) {
  visit_breaks <- sort(unique(plot_df$visit_day_num))
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = visit_day_factor, y = metric_value, fill = group_label)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.78),
      width = 0.68,
      outlier.alpha = 0.18
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = paste(metric_title, study_title),
      x = "Visit Days",
      y = y_label,
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal"
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = if (length(palette) > 2) 2 else 1, byrow = TRUE))
}

plot_followup_metric_spaghetti <- function(plot_df, metric_title, study_title, y_label, palette) {
  visit_breaks <- sort(unique(plot_df$visit_day_num))
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = visit_day_num, y = metric_value, color = group_label, group = pat_id)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.78, linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = palette, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = visit_breaks) +
    labs(
      title = paste(metric_title, study_title),
      x = "Visit",
      y = y_label,
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal"
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = if (length(palette) > 2) 2 else 1, byrow = TRUE))
}

followup_metric_plot_data <- list()
if (show_followup_study_plots && nrow(df) > 0) {
  for (metric_name in names(followup_metric_specs)) {

    followup_metric_plot_data[[paste0(metric_name, "_obs")]] <- prepare_followup_study_metric_df(df, metric_name, study_type = "observational")
  }
}

if (nrow(df) > 0) {
  preview_core <- df %>%
    transmute(
      Participant = pat_id,

  preview_behavior <- df %>%

  preview_lab_cols <- intersect(

    names(df)

  preview_labs <- utils::head(df[, preview_lab_cols, drop = FALSE], 10)
  lab_preview_labels <- c(
    pat_id = "Participant",

    total_bilirubin = "Total bilirubin",

if (source_index == "aliquot") {

  if (!is.null(biospecimen_summary$biospecimensPerParticipant) && length(biospecimen_summary$biospecimensPerParticipant) > 0) {

  if (nrow(biospecimen_preview) > 0) {
    biospecimen_preview <- ensure_columns(
      biospecimen_preview,
      c("aliquot_id", "specimen_type", "lab_name", "PI_name", "name_of_institute", "follow_up_id", "pat_id", "study_site")

      transmute(
        `Aliquot ID` = aliquot_id,
        `Specimen type` = specimen_type,

        `Follow-up ID` = follow_up_id,
        Participant = pat_id,
        Site = short_site(study_site)
      ) %>%

}

  if (nrow(lab_result_preview) > 0) {

      c("molecular_test_id", "laboratory_test", "test_value", "test_unit", "lab_name", "PI_name", "name_of_institute", "follow_up_id", "pat_id", "study_site")
    )
    lab_result_preview <- lab_result_preview %>%
      transmute(

        `Laboratory test` = laboratory_test,
        Value = test_value,

        `Follow-up ID` = follow_up_id,
        Participant = pat_id,
        Site = short_site(study_site)
      ) %>%
      utils::head(10)
  }
}

## Data Completeness

This section summarizes field coverage across `r data_completeness_subject`. `r row_representation_sentence`

For numeric clinical fields, blank source values are treated as missing and are not recoded to zero. A low coverage percentage therefore indicates missing measurements, not true zero-valued observations.

```{r, results='asis'}
if (nrow(availability_table) == 0) {
  cat("No field availability summary was provided.\n")
} else {
  render_table(availability_table, paste0("Field coverage across ", data_completeness_subject, "."), align = "lrrl")
}
```

```{r, results='asis'}
unavailable <- meta$unavailableFields
if (!is.null(unavailable) && length(unavailable) > 0) {
  label_unavailable <- ifelse(unavailable %in% names(field_labels), unname(field_labels[unavailable]), unavailable)
  cat("Fields currently excluded from this report: ")
  cat(paste(label_unavailable, collapse = ", "))
  cat("\n")
}

if (nrow(alcohol_plot_df) > 0) {

    ggplot(alcohol_plot_df, aes(x = visit_day_label, y = n, fill = alcohol_use_baseline)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.72) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("No" = "#d9d9d9", "Yes" = "#8c2d5d"), drop = FALSE) +
      labs(x = "Visit day", y = "Number of follow-up rows", fill = "Alcohol use") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
      theme(
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top"
      )
  } else {
    ggplot(alcohol_single_visit_df, aes(x = alcohol_use_baseline, y = n, fill = alcohol_use_baseline)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.62, show.legend = FALSE) +
      geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.8) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("No" = "#d9d9d9", "Yes" = "#8c2d5d"), drop = FALSE) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of follow-up rows") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
      theme(
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")
      ) +
      expand_limits(y = max(alcohol_single_visit_df$n, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15)

```{r lab_heatmap, fig.cap="Coverage heatmap for laboratory fields across visit days. Darker cells indicate higher percent coverage among follow-up rows at that visit day.", fig.width=9.2, fig.height=6.2, out.width='98%', fig.pos='H'}
if (nrow(lab_heatmap_df) > 0 && lab_heatmap_active_visits > 1) {
  ggplot(lab_heatmap_df, aes(x = visit_day_label, y = field, fill = coverage)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f7fbff", high = "#08306b", limits = c(0, 100), name = "Coverage %") +
    labs(x = "Visit day", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}
```

```{r sex_stratified_meld, fig.cap="Median MELD score across visit days, stratified by sex. Error bars show the interquartile range within each sex group.", fig.width=8.8, fig.height=4.8, out.width='96%', fig.pos='H'}
if (nrow(sex_trend_df) > 0 && sex_trend_active_visits > 1 && sex_trend_active_groups > 1) {
  ggplot(sex_trend_df, aes(x = visit_day_num, y = median, color = gender)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = q1, ymax = q3), width = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Male" = "#8c2d5d", "Female" = "#2b8cbe", "Unknown" = "#7f7f7f")) +
      labs(x = "Visit day", y = "Median MELD score", color = "Sex") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
      theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")
}
```

## Visit-Specific Summaries

```{r visit_sections, results='asis'}
if (length(visit_groups) == 0) {
  cat("No visit-specific summaries are available.\n")
} else {
  for (key in names(visit_groups)) {
    visit_df <- visit_groups[[key]]
    visit_title <- visit_label(key)
    visit_overview <- data.frame(
      Metric = c("Rows included", "Unique participants", "Participants with repeated rows"),
      Value = c(
        nrow(visit_df),
        dplyr::n_distinct(visit_df$pat_id),
        sum(table(visit_df$pat_id) > 1)
      ),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      check.names = FALSE
    )
    visit_availability <- make_availability_table(visit_df)
    visit_metrics <- make_metrics_table(visit_df)
    visit_alcohol <- if ("alcohol_use_baseline" %in% names(visit_df)) count_pct(visit_df$alcohol_use_baseline) else data.frame()

    cat("\n\n### ", visit_title, "\n\n", sep = "")
    render_table(visit_overview, paste0("Overview for ", tolower(visit_title), "."), align = "ll")

    if (nrow(visit_availability) > 0) {
      cat("\n")
      render_table(visit_availability, paste0("Field coverage for ", tolower(visit_title), "."), align = "lrrl")
    }

    if (nrow(visit_alcohol) > 0) {
      cat("\n")
      render_table(visit_alcohol, paste0("Alcohol use distribution for ", tolower(visit_title), "."), align = "lrr")
    }

    if (nrow(visit_metrics) > 0) {
      cat("\n")
      render_table(visit_metrics, paste0("Clinical measurements and laboratory values for ", tolower(visit_title), "."), align = "lll")
    }
  }
}
```
